name: @saas/idempotency
description: Shared idempotency guard for saas-builder and generated templates: an Idempotency-Key HTTP middleware (Supabase-backed, replay-safe, 409 on concurrent in-flight retries), a generic withIdempotency(key, fn) side-effect wrapper (Stripe-call-aware), and a distributed Redis SET NX + TTL lock with heartbeat extension. Consolidates the recurring 'retry/concurrent execution double-runs a money or externally-visible side effect' pattern (see error KB: stripe_recurring_subscription_missing_conflict_guard, cron_owner_digest_no_idempotency, affiliate_commission_idempotency_missing, redis_nx_lock_ttl_too_short) into one reviewed, tested package instead of re-solving it per call site.
